test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In case an Indian citizen is arrested and denied the right to be defended, then in such a situation, which Article of the Indian Constitution can provide a relief?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 22.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 22** of the Indian Constitution provides relief to an** Indian citizen **who is arrested and denied the** right to be defended.**
 
• **Article 22(1) **provides that every person who is arrested and detained in custody shall be informed of the grounds of such arrest and shall be allowed to consult and be defended by a legal practitioner of his choice
 
• **Article 22(2) states** that every person who is arrested and detained in custody shall be produced before the nearest magistrate within a period of 24 hours of such arrest.
 
• **Article 22(4**) states that **no law** providing for preventive detention shall authorise the** detention of a person** for a longer period than **three months** unless an Advisory Board has reported before the expiration of the said period that there is, in its opinion,** sufficient cause** for such detention.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 23 **deals with the prohibition of traffic in human beings and forced labour.
 
• **Article 24** prohibits the employment of children in factories, etc.
 
• **Article 25 **deals with freedom of conscience and free profession, practice and propagation of religion.
 
• Hence, the statement 1 is** correct.**
